rwyrh6.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a ban on pedestrian traffic
rwyrh6.why: It is not an advance warning of a ban; it only marks the end of the pedestrian path.

eqjkr4.q: The sign shown prohibits pedestrians from crossing the road
eqjkr4.why: It prohibits nothing for pedestrians; it marks the end of the path reserved for them.

1x9mg1x.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of the end of an area closed to pedestrians
1x9mg1x.why: It does not concern an area closed to pedestrians; it marks the end of a path reserved for them.

1m2ol1.q: The sign shown is placed at a route closed to cars and motorcycles
1m2ol1.why: The sign marks a route reserved for bicycles; cars, motorcycles and other motor vehicles are not allowed.

1jytymg.q: The sign shown is placed at a route reserved for bicycles
1jytymg.why: The sign marks a route reserved for bicycles; cars, motorcycles and other motor vehicles are not allowed.

1l1mum2.q: The sign shown is placed at a cycle crossing regulated by a traffic light
1l1mum2.why: Traffic lights are not involved: it marks the start of a route reserved for bicycles.

1k8hg79.q: The sign shown prohibits bicycles from passing
1k8hg79.why: On the contrary, it reserves the route for bicycles; a ban on bicycles uses a red-bordered circle.

11v53rs.q: The sign shown is placed at a route for pedestrians and bicycles
11v53rs.why: A shared route shows pedestrian and bicycle together; here only the bicycle appears.

6enc5k.q: The sign shown is placed at a track reserved for bicycles and mopeds
6enc5k.why: The track is reserved for bicycles only; mopeds (ciclomotori) are not admitted.

1cpg3wi.q: The sign shown is placed at a route open to pedestrians and bicycles
1cpg3wi.why: It is reserved for bicycles only; pedestrians may not use it.

wuxebf.q: The sign shown is placed at an area closed to bicycle traffic
wuxebf.why: It means the opposite: a route reserved for bicycles, not an area closed to them.

e3f3k6.q: The sign shown is placed at the end of the cycle path
e3f3k6.why: The diagonal bar marks the end of the cycle path (pista ciclabile), the route reserved for bicycles.

1bdss0.q: The sign shown is placed at the end of a route that can be used by bicycles only
1bdss0.why: The diagonal bar marks the end of the cycle path (pista ciclabile), the route reserved for bicycles.

1qrqdnm.q: The sign shown is placed at the end of a track reserved for bicycles
1qrqdnm.why: The diagonal bar marks the end of the cycle path (pista ciclabile), the route reserved for bicycles.

w5lavy.q: The sign shown indicates a parking ban for bicycles
w5lavy.why: It has nothing to do with parking; it marks the end of the cycle path.

wahb.q: The sign shown prohibits bicycles and mopeds from passing
wahb.why: It is not a ban; it marks the end of the cycle path.

mq5kyk.q: The sign shown is placed at the end of the pedestrian and cycle path
mq5kyk.why: It shows only a bicycle: it marks the end of a cycle path, not of a shared pedestrian and cycle path.

p7gn6i.q: The sign shown announces that cyclists and pedestrians are no longer allowed to pass
p7gn6i.why: It is not an advance warning and does not involve pedestrians; it only marks the end of the cycle path.

dt8xyd.q: The sign shown is placed at the start of an area closed to bicycles
dt8xyd.why: It marks the end of a route reserved for bicycles, not the start of an area closed to them.

19zsxh2.q: The sign shown is placed at the start of a cycle track next to the pavement
19zsxh2.why: The sign with a pedestrian and a bicycle split by a line marks a cycle path next to a pedestrian path, kept separate.

jczlfs.q: The sign shown is placed at the start of a track reserved for bicycles, alongside a pedestrian walkway
jczlfs.why: The sign with a pedestrian and a bicycle split by a line marks a cycle path next to a pedestrian path, kept separate.

5sd2nj.q: The sign shown is placed at the start of a cycle route next to a pedestrian route
5sd2nj.why: The sign with a pedestrian and a bicycle split by a line marks a cycle path next to a pedestrian path, kept separate.

p9ciai.q: The sign shown is placed at a single route for pedestrians and cyclists
p9ciai.why: The dividing line separates the two flows: they are separate paths, not one shared route.

1rjp146.q: The sign shown is placed at a mixed walkway reserved for both pedestrians and cyclists
1rjp146.why: A shared path has no dividing line; here pedestrians and cyclists have distinct paths.

lngp4.q: The sign shown is placed at the end of the lanes reserved for pedestrians and bicycles
lngp4.why: This sign marks the start of separated pedestrian and bicycle lanes. The end is shown by the same sign crossed by a diagonal bar.

ljlr0s.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of the obligation to walk the bicycle
ljlr0s.why: It shows a path with separate lanes for pedestrians and cyclists, so cyclists may ride. It gives no notice of any duty to push the bicycle.

3bgcy2.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of the obligation to park the bicycle and continue on foot
3bgcy2.why: It is a separated pedestrian and cycle path sign. It does not require you to park the bicycle or continue on foot.

ky4de1.q: The sign shown is placed at a single path shared by pedestrians and cyclists
ky4de1.why: Pedestrian and bicycle symbols without a dividing line mean a single shared path (percorso promiscuo) for pedestrians and cyclists.

ucdjw9.q: The sign shown is placed at a mixed lane reserved for both pedestrians and cyclists
ucdjw9.why: The sign marks a shared path (percorso promiscuo) reserved for both pedestrians and cyclists, who use the same space.

ffbwol.q: The sign shown is placed at a route reserved only for the passage of pedestrians and cyclists
ffbwol.why: The shared path is reserved for pedestrians and cyclists only. All other vehicles are excluded.

olh2bj.q: The sign shown is placed at a cycle track beside the pavement
olh2bj.why: The sign shows one shared path for pedestrians and cyclists, not a cycle track next to the pavement.

1vyupur.q: The sign shown is placed at a cycle track beside a path reserved for pedestrians
1vyupur.why: Pedestrians and cyclists share the same path with no separation. A side-by-side cycle track would be shown with a dividing line.

8lfnts.q: The sign shown is placed at a pedestrian area next to a cycle route
8lfnts.why: It marks one shared path, not two side-by-side routes, one for pedestrians and one for cyclists.

17fou8z.q: The sign shown is placed at a pedestrian path next to a bicycle path, separated by a traffic divider
17fou8z.why: The sign does not show separate paths. Pedestrians and cyclists share one path. Separate paths use a sign with a dividing line.

1vjqad9.q: The sign shown is placed at an area open to bicycles only if they are walked by hand
1vjqad9.why: Cyclists may ride along the path, sharing it with pedestrians. There is no duty to push the bicycle.

hmocwb.q: The sign shown is placed at the end of the cycle track beside the pavement
hmocwb.why: The separated-path sign crossed by a diagonal bar marks the end of the separated route, including the cycle track beside the pavement.

18g77fl.q: The sign shown is placed at the end of the cycle track beside a path reserved for pedestrians
18g77fl.why: The crossed-out sign marks the end of the separated path, so also the end of the cycle track beside the pedestrian one.

10yynbk.q: The sign shown is placed at the end of the pedestrian path beside the cycle track
10yynbk.why: The diagonal bar marks the end of the separated pedestrian and cycle path, including the pedestrian part.

ltfzbe.q: The sign shown is placed at the end of the pedestrian path next to a cycle path
ltfzbe.why: The crossed-out sign ends the path with separate lanes for pedestrians and cyclists, pedestrian lane included.

spsw6g.q: The sign shown prohibits the passage of all two-wheeled vehicles
spsw6g.why: It is a mandatory-type sign marking the end of a pedestrian and cycle path. It is not a ban on two-wheeled vehicles.

11zu8q6.q: The sign shown prohibits the passage of bicycles that are walked by hand
11zu8q6.why: It only marks the end of the separated pedestrian and cycle path. It prohibits nothing, including walking a bicycle by hand.

h57a5v.q: The sign shown is placed at a path reserved for pedestrians on some days and for bicycles on others
h57a5v.why: There is no alternating-days rule. The sign marks the end of a path with separate lanes for pedestrians and cyclists.

1xa5y5e.q: The sign shown prohibits pedestrians from entering at night
1xa5y5e.why: The sign has no time-based ban. It marks the end of the separated pedestrian and cycle path.

1sstghs.q: The sign shown is placed at the end of the single pedestrian and cycle path
1sstghs.why: The diagonal bar over the shared-path sign marks the end of the single pedestrian and cycle path.

u344bg.q: The sign shown is placed at the end of the route reserved for mixed circulation of pedestrians and cyclists
u344bg.why: The crossed-out sign marks the end of the shared path (percorso promiscuo) for pedestrians and cyclists.

12z0a8h.q: The sign shown is placed at a path reserved for pedestrians and bicycles
12z0a8h.why: The sign is crossed out, so it marks the end, not the start, of the path reserved for pedestrians and bicycles.

rs53ah.q: The sign shown is placed at the end of the cycle track only
rs53ah.why: The sign concerns the shared path of pedestrians and cyclists, not a cycle track alone.

mddsn4.q: The sign shown prohibits the passage of bicycles walked by hand
mddsn4.why: It only marks the end of the shared path. It does not ban bicycles walked by hand.

1ahsax8.q: The sign shown is placed at the end of the pedestrian path only
1ahsax8.why: It marks the end of the shared path for pedestrians and cyclists together, not of a pedestrian path alone.

9v02rz.q: The sign shown does not allow vehicles to pass
9v02rz.why: This is the bridleway sign (percorso riservato ai cavalli), reserved for saddle and pack animals. Vehicles may not enter.

17h77u6.q: The sign shown does not allow bicycles to pass
17h77u6.why: The path is reserved for saddle and pack animals. Bicycles, being vehicles, may not use it.

v7cqrq.q: The sign shown does not allow vehicles with an electric motor to pass
v7cqrq.why: The path is reserved for saddle and pack animals. Every vehicle, electric ones included, is excluded.

17xetk2.q: The sign shown is placed at the start of a path reserved for saddle animals
17xetk2.why: The sign marks the start of a path reserved for saddle animals (and pack animals).

abgb5n.q: The sign shown is placed at the start of a path reserved for pack animals
abgb5n.why: The sign marks the start of a path reserved for pack animals (and saddle animals).

18aw0w8.q: The sign shown is placed near a riding school
18aw0w8.why: The sign does not indicate riding schools. It marks a path reserved for saddle and pack animals.

kmbmq3.q: The sign shown is a danger sign
kmbmq3.why: It is a mandatory sign (blue and round), not a danger sign. Danger signs are triangular with a red border.

8tiu6j.q: The sign shown prohibits the passage of pack and saddle animals
8tiu6j.why: On the contrary, the sign reserves the path for pack and saddle animals. It does not ban them.

vyvo0g.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of the presence of stray animals
vyvo0g.why: It is not a warning sign. It marks a path reserved for saddle and pack animals. Stray animals have a triangular danger sign.

1hp51cu.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of the obligation to give way to animals crossing
1hp51cu.why: It has nothing to do with giving way or crossings. It marks a path reserved for saddle and pack animals.

2gfrhx.q: The sign shown is placed at the end of a path for pack animals
2gfrhx.why: The diagonal bar marks the end of the path reserved for pack animals (and saddle animals).

1fb4aes.q: The sign shown is placed at the end of a path for saddle animals
1fb4aes.why: The diagonal bar marks the end of the path reserved for saddle animals (and pack animals).

1ilovgc.q: The sign shown is placed at the end of the path reserved for pack and saddle animals
1ilovgc.why: The crossed-out sign marks the end of the path reserved for pack and saddle animals.

1benbfc.q: The sign shown is placed near a racecourse
1benbfc.why: It does not indicate racecourses. It marks the end of a path reserved for saddle and pack animals.

s80yhr.q: The sign shown prohibits the passage of animal-drawn vehicles
s80yhr.why: It is not a prohibition. It marks the end of the path reserved for saddle and pack animals.

140ncl1.q: The sign shown is placed at the end of a stretch of road prohibited to horses
140ncl1.why: It marks the end of a path reserved for horses, not the end of a stretch where horses are banned.

1xkx8rb.q: The sign shown is placed at the end of a path reserved only for racehorses
1xkx8rb.why: The path is reserved for saddle and pack animals in general, not only for racehorses.

1halv5q.q: The sign shown requires stopping at the customs gate
1halv5q.why: The DOGANA sign (red circle with a bar) requires you to stop at the customs gate (varco doganale).

1odinr9.q: The sign shown requires stopping at the border for customs inspection
1odinr9.why: The DOGANA sign requires you to stop at the border for customs inspection.

oaw2c2.q: The sign shown indicates that you must slow down and stop at customs
oaw2c2.why: The DOGANA sign requires you to slow down and stop at the customs post.

1owixuk.q: The sign shown marks a customs gate where stopping is mandatory
1owixuk.why: The DOGANA sign marks a customs gate (varco doganale) where stopping is compulsory.

4q7h7g.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a police station
4q7h7g.why: The DOGANA sign relates to customs control and requires a stop. It does not announce a police station.

15ckd6v.q: The sign shown requires slowing down and stopping at the customs gate only if you have goods to declare
15ckd6v.why: Stopping at the customs gate is compulsory for everyone, not only for those with goods to declare.

hi2pyj.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a Carabinieri station
hi2pyj.why: The DOGANA sign requires a stop at the customs gate. It does not announce a Carabinieri station.

1pti6nh.q: The sign shown is found only at the border with a European Community country
1pti6nh.why: The sign is used at any customs gate, including borders with countries outside the European Community.

mdwhu1.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a road block set up by the police
mdwhu1.why: The ALT POLIZIA sign marks a road block (posto di blocco) set up by the police.

1e8m9xb.q: The sign shown requires stopping near a road block set up by the police
1e8m9xb.why: The ALT POLIZIA sign requires you to stop at the police road block.

a1qk3o.q: The sign shown indicates the obligation to stop at a road block set up by the police
a1qk3o.why: The ALT POLIZIA sign indicates the duty to stop at a road block set up by the police.

1cak03w.q: The sign shown marks a road block set up by the police at which stopping is mandatory
1cak03w.why: The ALT POLIZIA sign marks a police road block where stopping is compulsory.

nhjpiu.q: The sign shown, placed at a suitable distance from the road block, is repeated at the stopping point
nhjpiu.why: The ALT POLIZIA sign is placed at a suitable distance before the road block and repeated at the point where you must stop.

d07vh9.q: The sign shown requires slowing down so as to be ready to stop if signalled by officers
d07vh9.why: The sign requires a compulsory stop at the road block, not just slowing down and waiting for an officer's signal.

ddt26s.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a state border with an obligation to stop
ddt26s.why: The ALT POLIZIA sign marks a police road block. A state border is marked by the DOGANA sign.

b8qmp5.q: The sign shown marks a motorway station at which stopping is mandatory
b8qmp5.why: The ALT POLIZIA sign marks a police road block. A motorway station has the ALT STAZIONE sign.

16427bx.q: The sign shown requires stopping and giving way to police vehicles
16427bx.why: The sign requires you to stop at the police road block. It is not about giving way to police vehicles.

1eh1f18.q: The sign shown indicates the proximity of a customs checkpoint
1eh1f18.why: The ALT POLIZIA sign marks a police road block, not a customs check (that is the DOGANA sign).

u6hjov.q: The sign shown requires stopping at the motorway entrance
u6hjov.why: The ALT STAZIONE sign requires you to stop at the motorway station (casello) at the entrance.

176byw0.q: The sign shown imposes the obligation to slow down and stop for motorway toll operations
176byw0.why: The ALT STAZIONE sign requires you to slow down and stop for toll operations (pedaggio).

fqtet9.q: The sign shown marks a motorway station at which stopping is mandatory
fqtet9.why: The ALT STAZIONE sign marks the motorway station where stopping is compulsory.

15wmadk.q: The sign shown requires stopping at the motorway toll booth for toll operations
15wmadk.why: The ALT STAZIONE sign requires you to stop at the motorway toll booth (casello) to pay the toll.

1xjk3e7.q: The sign shown is placed at controlled motorway entrances where stopping is mandatory
1xjk3e7.why: The ALT STAZIONE sign is placed at controlled motorway entrances, where you must stop.

bgtcxp.q: The sign shown marks a Carabinieri station, with a road block
bgtcxp.why: The ALT STAZIONE sign refers to the motorway station. It does not mark a Carabinieri station or a road block.

wmu76d.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a railway station
wmu76d.why: The sign means the motorway station (casello), not a railway station.

rf0l4t.q: The sign shown prohibits access to an area reserved for the motorway company's vehicles
rf0l4t.why: The sign requires a stop at the motorway station. It does not ban access to a reserved area.

4gzmub.q: The sign shown indicates the point where you must stop to load the car onto the train
4gzmub.why: The ALT STAZIONE sign concerns motorway toll stations, not loading cars onto a train.

uhzd7a.q: The sign shown may indicate the stopping point at ferry boarding piers
uhzd7a.why: The ALT STAZIONE sign refers to motorway stations. It is not used for ferry boarding piers.

2aztr3.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a mandatory right turn for trucks with a mass over 3.5 t
2aztr3.why: The sign gives advance notice that trucks over 3.5 t must turn right.

16zwlcl.q: The sign shown prohibits trucks with a mass over 3.5 t from continuing straight ahead
16zwlcl.why: Since trucks over 3.5 t must turn right, they may not continue straight ahead.

1dpqhwz.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of the obligation to turn right for the vehicles depicted on the sign
1dpqhwz.why: The sign gives advance notice that the vehicles shown on it (trucks) must turn right.

p04puk.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a ban on turning left for trucks with a mass over 3.5 t
p04puk.why: If trucks over 3.5 t must turn right, turning left is forbidden for them.

3fvi3z.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a mandatory turn for the vehicles depicted on the sign
3fvi3z.why: The sign gives advance notice of a mandatory turn, to the right, for the vehicles shown on it.

8sno8g.q: The sign shown gives advance notice that trucks over 3.5 t must turn in the direction of the arrow
8sno8g.why: Trucks over 3.5 t must turn in the direction of the arrow, here to the right.

zknpfl.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a refuelling station for trucks
zknpfl.why: It is an advance notice of a mandatory turn for trucks, not of a refuelling station.

13r1jm4.q: The sign shown gives advance notice that turning right is recommended for trucks
13r1jm4.why: Turning right for trucks over 3.5 t is an obligation, not a recommendation.

ocqgxv.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a ban on turning right for the vehicles shown in the figure
ocqgxv.why: The blue sign with an arrow gives notice of an obligation to turn right, not a ban.

1d4p0nc.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a parking area reserved for trucks
1d4p0nc.why: The sign gives notice of a mandatory turn for trucks, not a parking area.

182qyzi.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a mandatory left turn for all trucks
182qyzi.why: The arrow points right, not left, and applies to trucks over 3.5 t, not to all trucks.

1bf8sap.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a dangerous right-hand bend for trucks in transit
1bf8sap.why: It is not a danger sign. It gives notice of a mandatory right turn for trucks over 3.5 t.
